meta.title: Online course platform (LMS)
meta.seoTitle: LMS demo: online course platform with an AI tutor
meta.seoDescription: Interactive demo of a course platform for a sample academy in Colombia: catalog priced in COP, simulated checkout with PSE, card or Nequi, lessons with subtitles, an AI tutor that cites the lesson and minute, assessment, adaptive path, certificates with a verifiable QR code, and instructor and admin dashboards.

header.subtitle: Online course platform · demo with sample data
header.sampleHint: Fictitious academy. Payments, e-invoicing, emails and live classes are simulated; the tutor uses real AI over the course material.
header.resetHint: Go back to the initial sample data
header.resetBody: This deletes your purchases, progress, notes, new certificates, coupons and courses created in this browser, and restores the initial sample data.
header.resetDone: Done: the demo is back to the sample data.

stats.note: Figures calculated from the demo sample data; they change with what you do (purchases, lessons, published courses).

catalog.title: Course catalog
catalog.subtitle: Sample courses from a continuing education academy. Prices in Colombian pesos, VAT included.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by course, instructor or topic…

detail.certPolicy: issued when you complete every lesson and pass the final assessment with {pct}% or more. It includes a code and a verification QR.
detail.summaryNote: The demo shows a condensed version with {count} lessons; the full program is {hours} hours long.
detail.draftHint: Draft: publish it to sell it

checkout.title: Buy course
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.pseHint: The demo does not open any bank: the payment is approved in a simulation.
checkout.nequiHint: In a real project the customer approves the payment in the app; here it is approved in a simulation.
checkout.terms: I accept the purchase terms and authorize the processing of my personal data under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 (sample texts).
checkout.simNote: Simulated payment: nothing is charged and no data is sent to any gateway. In your project it connects to Wompi or PayU (PSE, card and Nequi) and the electronic invoice is issued by your DIAN-authorized provider.
checkout.errDoc: Type your ID using digits only (5 to 12 digits).
checkout.errCard: The card number is not valid.
checkout.errPhone: Type a 10-digit Colombian mobile number starting with 3.
checkout.errTerms: You must accept the terms and the data authorization.
checkout.approvedBody: You now have access to “{course}”. You will find it in My courses.
checkout.doneNote: In a real project you would get an email at {email} with your access and the electronic invoice. The demo does not send any email.

receipt.title: Payment receipt
receipt.sample: SAMPLE DOCUMENT generated by the demo: it is not an electronic invoice and has no tax validity.
receipt.footer: Sample academy created for the Koptup demo. In your project, the payment is processed by the gateway (Wompi or PayU) and the electronic invoice is issued by your DIAN-authorized provider.

learning.empty: You do not have any courses yet. Buy or enroll in one from the catalog.
learning.certToast: Certificate {code} issued! See it in Certificates.

player.simNote: The demo has no real video: the lesson moves forward with a simulated clock that follows the selected speed, and the subtitles come from the lesson script, in Spanish or English. In your project, videos are hosted on a video service (Vimeo, Mux or similar).
player.noContent: This lesson has no content yet.
player.quizLesson: Answer the {count} assessment questions to finish the course.
player.notesPlaceholder: Write a note about this lesson…
player.notesHint: Notes are saved in this browser.
player.goToNote: Go to that point of the lesson

tutor.title: AI tutor
tutor.subtitle: Answers with this course’s material
tutor.welcome: Hi, I am the tutor of “{course}”. Ask me about the lessons and I will answer with the course material, citing the lesson and the minute.
tutor.openSource: Go to this part of the lesson
tutor.statusIdle: Real AI (through Koptup’s server) over the lesson scripts. Every answer cites its sources.
tutor.statusLlm: An AI model ({model}) answered using only the course material.
tutor.statusExtractive_noKey: The server has no AI configured: showing the most relevant passages of the material, without rewriting them.
tutor.statusExtractive_budget: The demo’s AI quota ran out: showing the most relevant passages of the material.
tutor.statusExtractive_provider: The AI provider failed: showing the most relevant passages of the material.
tutor.statusLocal: No connection with the server: local search in the material, without AI.
tutor.localNone: I could not find that information in this course’s material. Try other words or one of the suggested questions.
tutor.rateLimited: You asked many questions in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
tutor.noMaterial: This course has no text material for the tutor. Add it when you create the course (text of each lesson).
tutor.privacy: Your questions are sent to Koptup’s server only to answer them in this demo. Do not type personal data.

quiz.title: Final assessment
quiz.intro: {count} questions about the course lessons. You pass with {pct}% or more; otherwise, the path recommends what to review.
quiz.review: Review these lessons before trying again:
quiz.pendingLessons: {count, plural, one {# lesson left to get the certificate.} other {# lessons left to get the certificate.}}

path.title: Adaptive path
path.subtitle: It adapts to your result: below {pct}% in the assessment it suggests a review of the lessons behind the questions you missed; if you pass, it suggests the next course.

live.title: Live classes
live.subtitle: Academy sessions with breakout rooms and subtitles (simulated room).
live.rooms: {count, plural, one {# breakout room} other {# breakout rooms}}
live.reminderOn: Reminder on. In your project it arrives by email or WhatsApp 15 minutes before (simulated here).
live.icsDone: You downloaded the event (.ics) for your calendar.
live.icsNote: Sample session from Koptup’s LMS demo.
live.openClass: Class open to the whole academy community.
live.simNote: Classes are simulated. In your project they are created in Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams from the platform, and attendance is recorded automatically.
live.handRaised: You raised your hand: the host will give you the floor.
live.roomNote: Simulated room: the host’s script appears as subtitles in Spanish or English and you can move between breakout rooms. In your project you use the features of the platform you choose (Zoom, Meet or Teams).

gamification.title: Achievements
gamification.subtitle: Your points come from what you do in the demo: lessons, assessments and certificates.
gamification.weekly: Weekly challenge: complete {goal} lessons in 7 days (+{xp} XP)
gamification.howQuiz: {n} assessments passed × {xp} XP, plus {bonus} XP for each perfect score ({perfect})
gamification.leaderboardNote: Sample classmates; your score is the real one from the demo.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.subtitle: With a unique code and a QR that opens the verification page.
certificates.nameHint: Type your name to see your certificates with it (saved only in this browser).
certificates.noCerts: You do not have certificates yet. Complete a course and pass the final assessment.
certificates.downloaded: You downloaded the certificate as a PDF.
certificates.simNote: Sample certificates. The verification page checks a sample signature carried in the link; in your project the code is looked up in the server’s certificate registry.
certificates.pdfSample: SAMPLE DOCUMENT generated by the Koptup demo. Fictitious academy: this certificate does not accredit real studies.

analytics.title: Instructor analytics
analytics.subtitle: Sample cohorts from the academy plus your own progress in the demo.
analytics.trendHint: Students who came in to study each day.
analytics.gaugeLabel: of those who have not finished are at high risk
analytics.riskRule: Transparent rule (not AI): high risk if 14 or more days without activity and below 80%; medium if 7 or more days without activity, or 4 days with less than 30%.
analytics.atRiskCount: {count, plural, one {# student at medium or high risk} other {# students at medium or high risk}}
analytics.remindAllDone: {count, plural, one {Reminder sent to # student (simulated).} other {Reminders sent to # students (simulated).}}
analytics.remindNote: Reminders are simulated: no message is sent. In your project they go out by email or WhatsApp Business.
analytics.noRisk: No students at risk in this course.
analytics.lessonRateHint: Share of enrolled students who have reached each lesson.

authoring.title: Create courses
authoring.subtitle: Build a course in 4 steps, save it as a draft and publish it to the catalog (stored in this browser).
authoring.lessonContentPh: Paste the script or a summary. The AI tutor uses it as material and the simulated video shows it as subtitles.
authoring.filesTypes: PDF, video, slides or SCORM package (.zip)
authoring.filesNote: In the demo, files never leave your browser: only the name and size are saved. In your project they are uploaded to storage and to the video service.
authoring.quizHint: Optional: add up to 5 questions. If you add at least one, the course will have a final assessment and a certificate when passed.
authoring.generateHint: Built with rules from the lesson text (no AI); review and edit them.
authoring.generateNone: Add text to the lessons (step 2) to generate questions: at least 4 sentences are needed.
authoring.generateDone: {count, plural, one {# question generated: review it.} other {# questions generated: review them.}}
authoring.publishedToast: Course published: it now shows in the catalog.
authoring.empty: You have not created any courses yet. Use “Create course” to build the first one.
authoring.deleteBody: This deletes “{title}” and, if you enrolled in it, your progress and notes for that course.
authoring.errTitle: The title must have at least 5 characters.
authoring.errDesc: The description must have at least 10 characters.
authoring.errPrice: The price must be between COP 0 and COP 20,000,000.
authoring.errModuleLessons: Module {n} needs at least one lesson.
authoring.errLessonTitle: Give lesson {n} of module {m} a title.

admin.salesSubtitle: Course sales for the last 30 days and the details of each payment (sample data plus your purchases in the demo).
admin.salesNote: Simulated payments and electronic invoices. In your project, payments come from Wompi or PayU and invoices are issued by your e-invoicing provider.
admin.couponsSubtitle: Create, enable or disable discount coupons; active ones work in the demo checkout.
admin.couponErrCode: Use 4 to 16 letters or digits, no spaces.
admin.couponErrPct: The discount must be between 5% and 50%.
admin.couponErrDup: A coupon with that code already exists.
admin.couponsNote: Uses count the sample sales and your purchases in the demo.
admin.issuedSubtitle: {count, plural, one {# certificate issued} other {# certificates issued}} at the sample academy.
admin.issuedNote: Sample students do not have individual certificates in the demo; yours do have a code and a verifiable QR.

verify.metaDescription: Certificate verification page for the sample academy in the LMS demo.
verify.title: Certificate verification
verify.name: Awarded to
verify.tamperedBody: The information in the link for certificate {code} was modified: the signature does not match.
verify.invalidBody: Scan the certificate QR or open the verification link from the demo.
verify.note: Sample verification: in the demo, the certificate data travels in the link with a sample signature. In your project, the code is looked up in the server’s certificate registry.
